name: TrueFocus-TS-TW
title: TrueFocus
description: A short sentence sits on a dark stage with all but one word softly blurred. Four corner brackets slide to whichever word is in focus and that word sharpens while the others soften.
use: A tagline should emphasise each keyword in turn without extra motion.
avoid: Body copy or forms: it needs a short phrase and pulls constant attention.
a11y: Focus only advances on a timer or through mouse hover in manual mode; no reduced-motion handling. (keyboard: no, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: The words "Design With True Focus" run in heavy white type across a black stage. One word is crisp while the rest are blurred, and four small white corner brackets frame the sharp word.
behaves: Roughly every second the brackets glide to the next word as that word snaps into focus and the others fade back into blur. It cycles through the sentence and starts over.
customise: The sentence, separator, blur amount, border and glow colours, duration, pause and manual mode are props. Word styling itself is fixed.
weight: light: A few blurred words and four animated border corners.
polishWhy: Crisp brackets and a clear focus loop; the blurred neighbours crowd the sharp word.
